output.visualIntent: Reference-led reconstruction of original scene order, shot timing and visual language, with newly authored poster artwork, a detailed Launch Kit interface, variable typography, textured 3D and an original 115 BPM score.

qualityGates: Full render must pass ffprobe at 1920x1080 and 30fps with duration 37.3s ±0.12s.
The opening title, prompt text, positioning line and model names must be legible at native resolution.
All 12 kinetic poster beats must appear in the correct order and stay within their shot windows.
The gallery wall must read as individual designed art rather than flat placeholder cards.
The Launch Kit is a coherent interface: prompt panel, model choice, preview viewport and consistent frame across preview changes.
Countdown numerals remain centered and do not collide with the UI frame.
The 3D cube has a stable silhouette, visible face depth, coherent perspective and no face flicker.
Audio beat grid and scene transitions align to the 115 BPM composition; loudness and true peak are measured.
Review the complete moving MP4 plus 1fps/2fps contact sheets; a green workflow is only a technical gate.
